title: Diamond Problem in Inheritance #1
statement: How does C++ resolve the "Diamond Problem" of multiple inheritance where class D inherits from B and C (both inheriting from A)?
explanation: Virtual base classes ensure that only one shared instance of base class A exists in derived class D.

title: Open-Closed Principle (SOLID) #2
statement: What is the core directive of the Open-Closed Principle (OCP) in software architecture?

options.text: Classes should expose all member variables directly
Functions should do exactly one thing
Interfaces must be fat and exhaustive
Software entities should be open for extension, but closed for modification

explanation: OCP requires that system behavior can be extended without altering existing verified source code.

title: Singleton Pattern & Thread Safety #3
statement: What pattern is commonly used in Java/C++ to implement high-performance thread-safe lazy Singleton initialization?
explanation: Double-checked locking checks the instance before and after lock acquisition to avoid synchronizing after initialization.
